  PROBLEM: The context table points implementers to `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:2574-2592` instead of the actual `sync_default_into_integration_branch()` definition.
  WHY: Following that reference sends readers to a comment region rather than the clean-sync code path, so they will edit the wrong location.
- docs/plans/integration-sync-resolver-self-heal-plan.md:39-42 | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The “What is wedged today” narrative repeats stale `2724-2727` references for the merges-API call even though those lines are fingerprint-capture code.
  WHY: A reader tracing the clean-sync path will land in the wrong region and miss the actual `sync_default_into_integration_branch()` call site.
- docs/plans/integration-sync-resolver-self-heal-plan.md:383 | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: Phase 3 moves the escape valve to “after `warn_only` itself fails N consecutive times,” but `warn_only` is defined to always pass, so the condition can never occur.
  WHY: That makes the escape valve unreachable for fingerprint-only loops and breaks the ladder’s terminus guarantee.
- docs/plans/integration-sync-resolver-self-heal-plan.md:299-318 | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The proposed `_verify_fingerprints_soft` replacement omits stdout redirection, violation extraction, and exit-code-2 fail-open handling, and it treats the intermediate and final verifier callsites as equivalent.
  WHY: Implemented literally, intermediate retries will spam annotations, lose retry-prelude bullets, and hard-fail on plumbing errors.
- docs/plans/integration-sync-resolver-self-heal-plan.md:376-380 | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The tier semantics define only `must_contain` behavior and never say how `must_not_contain` violations should behave at each tier.
  WHY: Implementers must guess whether those violations stay strict or relax with the tier, which changes safety materially.
- docs/plans/integration-sync-resolver-self-heal-plan.md:311-317 | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The compare-mode path does not define what happens when baseline capture succeeds but writes an empty, semantically valid baseline JSON.
  WHY: An empty baseline can classify every current fingerprint as a resolver regression and hard-fail when the verifier should pass.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
